cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Scientist skilled in the scientific method and data modeling to analyze and answer complex questions in the defense domain. You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers, and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.)
10+ Years of experience with 3 or more years on related programs and projects
At least 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
Hands-on experience applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real world problems
Expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc.
Experience using tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS or equivalent
Well-developed written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word and PowerPoint are a must)
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical information in layman's terms
Preferred Requirements
Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems
Relevant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, and an understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain
Familiarity with defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices, and an ability to apply them to solutions architecture
Hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions that include artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data, and analytics components
A proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations
A deep understanding of enterprise architecture framework and design patterns
Proficient knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools
Ability to design and implement solutions that meet defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs
A customer-oriented attitude and an understanding of critical details

cond_0045.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Scientist skilled in the scientific method and data modeling to analyze and answer complex questions in the defense domain. You will work alongside a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers, and a broad range of domain experts across a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and critical thinking to help ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will share your findings and recommendations with technical and non-technical audiences through clear and well-structured reports.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams on modeling projects for defense-related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles.
Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources in collaboration with analysts and domain experts.
Work with the team to develop and critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities.
Critique and help redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives.
Create and present reports that explain results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences.
Support and mentor junior data scientists and analysts on the team.
Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains and share relevant updates with the team.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.)
10+ Years of experience with 3 or more years on related programs and projects
At least 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility
Hands-on experience applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real-world problems
Expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc.
Experience using tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent
Well-developed written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint are a must)
Preferred Requirements
Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems
Relevant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, and an understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain
A proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations
A solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and design patterns
Hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions that include AI, machine learning, big data, and analytics components
Familiarity with defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices
Experience designing solutions that meet defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs
Proficiency across various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools

As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, you will take ownership of systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and critical thinking to ensure conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to determine next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will deliver findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences through clear and compelling reports.
cond_0053.responsibilities:
Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles.
Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources.
Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to uncover insights and identify opportunities.
Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives.
Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team.
Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0053.requirements:
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.)
10+ Years of experience with 3 or more years on related programs and projects.
At least 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems.
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Hands-on experience applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real world problems.
Experience using tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS or equivalent.
Well-developed written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word and PowerPoint are a must).
Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems is a plus.
Expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc.
A proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations.
A deep understanding of enterprise architecture framework and design patterns.
Hands-on experience in designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions that include artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data, and analytics components.
Relevant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, and an understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain.
A familiarity with the defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices, and an ability to apply them to the solutions architecture.
A capability to design and implement solutions that meet the defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs, and that enhance their mission readiness and effectiveness.
A proficient knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical information in layman's terms.
A customer-oriented attitude and an interest in creating innovative and effective solutions whilst understanding critical details.

cond_0163.intro:

You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers, and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.

A deep understanding of enterprise architecture framework and design patterns
Proficient knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools

cond_0222.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist skilled in the scientific method and data modeling to analyze and answer complex questions in the defense domain. You will regularly collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers, and a broad range of domain experts across a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will regularly communicate your findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Manage modeling projects for defense-related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles.
Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources.
Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities.
Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives.
Create and present reports that explain results and implications clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and handle questions from stakeholders directly.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts on the team.
Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.

You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports. Most people become stronger in this kind of modeling and analysis work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0230.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0230.requirements:
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.)
10+ Years of experience with 3 or more years on related programs and projects.
At least 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems.
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Hands-on experience applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real world problems.
Experience using tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS or equivalent.
Well-developed written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word and PowerPoint are a must).
Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems is a plus.
Expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc.
A proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations.
A deep understanding of enterprise architecture framework and design patterns.
Hands-on experience in designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions that include artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data, and analytics components.
Relevant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, and an understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain.
A familiarity with the defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices, and an ability to apply them to the solutions architecture.
A capability to design and implement solutions that meet the defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs, and that enhance their mission readiness and effectiveness.
A proficient knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical information in layman's terms.
A customer-oriented attitude and a passion for creating innovative and effective solutions whilst understanding critical details.

We are looking for a Senior Scientist skilled in the scientific method and data modeling to analyze and answer complex questions in the defense domain. You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports.
cond_0309.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0309.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.), or equivalent practical experience.
Around 10 years of experience overall, with around 3 or more years on related programs and projects.
Around 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Working knowledge of statistical modeling techniques applied to real-world problems.
Familiarity with tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent.
Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly in writing and verbally to non-analytical stakeholders; comfort with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Background in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Experience designing and delivering complex IT solutions for large enterprise-scale organizations.
Exposure to enterprise architecture frameworks and design patterns.
Experience designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions involving AI, machine learning, big data, and analytics components.
Experience with C5ISR defense systems and operations, and familiarity with the security challenges and requirements in this domain.
Familiarity with defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices.
Ability to design solutions that address defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs.
Working knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools.
Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems.
Willingness to engage with customers and contribute to practical, effective solutions while staying attentive to critical details.

You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports.
cond_0478.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0478.requirements: MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.) 10+ years of experience with 3 or more years on related programs and projects. At least 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems. Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Hands-on experience applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real world problems. Experience using tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS or equivalent. Well-developed written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word and PowerPoint are a must). Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems is a plus. Expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc. A proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations. A deep understanding of enterprise architecture framework and design patterns. Hands-on experience in designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions that include artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data, and analytics components. Relevant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, and an understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain. A familiarity with the defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices, and an ability to apply them to the solutions architecture. A capability to design and implement solutions that meet the defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs, and that enhance their mission readiness and effectiveness. A proficient knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical information in layman's terms. A customer-oriented attitude and an interest in creating innovative and effective solutions whilst understanding critical details.

We are looking for a Senior Scientist skilled in the scientific method and data modeling to analyze and answer complex questions in the defense domain. You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports.
cond_0524.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0524.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.) required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in relevant roles, with at least 3 years on directly related programs and projects.
At least 7 years of proven, hands-on expertise modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable domains.
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Deep expertise applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real-world problems, including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, and related methods.
Strong command of tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS, or equivalent.
Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint required).
Proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations.
Advanced knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and design patterns.
Preferred Requirements
Extensive hands-on expertise designing and implementing cloud-based, data-driven solutions incorporating artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data, and analytics components.
Significant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, with a solid understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain.
Proficiency in defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices, with the ability to apply them to solutions architecture.
Strong command of multiple programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement solutions that meet defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs.
Direct experience with a broad range of defense systems.

You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports. Most people become stronger in this kind of modeling and analysis work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0554.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
cond_0554.requirements:
MA/MS degree in a related scientific field (Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, etc.)
10+ Years of experience with 3 or more years on related programs and projects.
At least 7 years of experience modeling real-world systems in Engineering, Physics, Health, or comparable systems.
Active Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Hands-on experience applying a wide variety of statistical modeling techniques to real world problems.
Experience using tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, SPSS or equivalent.
Well-developed written and oral communication skills with ability to present complex statistical concepts to non-analytical stakeholders (Excel, Word and PowerPoint are a must).
Interest and/or direct experience with a broad range of defense systems is a plus.
Expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, deep learning, regression, decision trees, Bayesian inference, etc.
A proven track record of designing and delivering complex IT solutions for global enterprise-scale organizations.
A deep understanding of enterprise architecture framework and design patterns.
Hands-on experience in designing and implementing cloud-based data-driven solutions that include artificial intelligence, machine learning, big data, and analytics components.
Relevant experience in C5ISR defense systems and operations, and an understanding of the security challenges and requirements in this domain.
A familiarity with the defense industry standards, regulations, and best practices, and an ability to apply them to the solutions architecture.
A capability to design and implement solutions that meet the defense clients' operational, tactical, and strategic needs, and that enhance their mission readiness and effectiveness.
A proficient knowledge of various programming languages, platforms, frameworks, databases, cloud services, and software development tools.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical information in layman's terms.
A customer-oriented attitude and a passion for creating innovative and effective solutions whilst understanding critical details.

cond_0644.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Scientist skilled in the scientific method and data modeling skills to analyze and answer complex questions in the defense domain. You will collaborate with a team of scientists, engineers, analysts, data modelers and a broad range of domain experts on a wide range of problems.
As a Senior Scientist – Modeling, your emphasis will be in systems modeling, experimental design, research methods, and (most importantly) critical thinking to ensure that conclusions are supported by the available evidence. You should be comfortable critiquing research methods and conclusions and have the creativity to propose next steps. Direct experience or strong interest in a broad range of defense systems would be an advantage.
You will communicate your findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, using clear and compelling reports. Most people become stronger in this kind of modeling and analysis work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0644.responsibilities: Manage modeling projects for defense related applications in lead, individual contributor, or independent reviewer roles. Collect, integrate, and evaluate data from multiple sources. Develop and/or critique advanced predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and statistical methods to discover insights and identify opportunities. Critique and redesign experimental methods to achieve the desired objectives. Create and present reports that explain the results and implications to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists and analysts in the team. Stay current on the latest developments in modeling, AI/ML, and defense domains.
